request.description: Records up to 100 ops-verified facts in one go; all are validated against the dictionary first and nothing is saved if any fails. `value` may be a single value or, for numeric attributes, a `{min, max}` range (either bound may be null). `note` is kept as the source reference. Publishes `facts.recorded`. Staff only. Reading needs party read access (ops lead, compliance, support); recording needs party update access (ops lead, super admin). `partyId` comes from a lead or user record.
